summary: First-run E2E validation of Chronicle CMS (news + text watermark). Backend: 12/12 pytest passed against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend: verified NewsFeed loads, Create Article dialog publishes an article with attached image, backend applies Pillow text watermark, photo is stored in Emergent Object Storage, served via /api/files/<path> with image/jpeg, article detail shows watermarked hero photo (© Chronicle News Wire visible bottom-right), Watermark Settings page live preview updates when text is edited (URL param reflects new text and image reloads), Save persists settings, Media Library lists 3 watermarked assets with resolution/size and Watermarked ✓ badge, search + category filter + article delete all work.

issues: Success toast overlays the top-right area where the 'New Article' button sits; during automated navigation it briefly blocks pointer events near the navbar 'Watermark' link. Consider positioning toasts below the navbar or with pointer-events:none on the container so nav buttons remain reachable while a toast is visible.

action_items: Optional: adjust toast placement so it does not overlap the primary navbar CTAs (minor UX).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py apply_text_watermark() rejects raw uploads that Pillow cannot parse and correctly returns 400 via HTTPException — good.
GET /api/files/{path:path} gates delivery on a matching non-deleted DB record, so soft-deleted photos are inaccessible even though object storage still holds bytes — good.
All Mongo queries use projection {'_id': 0}, so ObjectId serialization is avoided.
Watermark position validation and opacity/font_size clamping are enforced server-side.
Consider adding an index on photos.article_id and articles.is_deleted for scale (not blocking for MVP).
list_articles() calls article_public() per doc, which triggers N+1 photos queries — fine for MVP volume; batch aggregation would be a future optimization.
test_credentials: N/A — app is fully open (no auth).
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_/E2E_ articles+photos during testing; the E2E_TEST_Watermark_Story article was deleted at the end. Remaining Media Library entries (test.png/test.jpg from earlier smoke, and Flood hits coastal town) are harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_chronicle_cms.py covers categories, watermark settings CRUD with clamping, /watermark/preview jpeg output, article CRUD + filters, photo upload with Pillow watermark, /api/files serving, non-image 400, /photos list with article_title, photo delete, article-delete cascade to photos, 404 on missing article. Data-testids from /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/news.js are all present and reliable. When automating navbar clicks right after a publish, the sonner toast may briefly overlap the 'Watermark' nav link — either wait ~5s for it to dismiss or navigate via page.goto('/watermark').
